units.source_text: 鹤川家里似乎发生了什么事，他请一周的假回东京去了。

en.t: Something seemed to have happened at Tsurukawa's home, and he took a week's leave and went back to Tokyo.

units.source_text: 使川决不是个好摊弄是非的人。

en.t: Tsurukawa was certainly not the sort of person who liked to stir up gossip or trouble.

units.source_text: 过去我每天早晨都和他一起上学，

en.t: In the past, I went to school with him every morning,
but now that he had gone,

units.source_text: 我就可以免去必须隐瞒我途中行踪的尴尬。

en.t: I could be spared the awkwardness of having to conceal where I went along the way.
